evidence: The base evidence contract records ordered observations of one remote ref, not identity-independent attesters. Two raw outputs are expected to be byte-identical when the ref is stable; inventing distinct content would stop them being canonical git ls-remote output.
Two separate live observations at 2026-09-02T05:20:41Z and 2026-09-02T05:20:48Z both returned 2699a18796e807e054bfbc227a43b615477b5b90 for refs/heads/dev.

The landing closeout maps the observations in order to different controller receipt hashes and strictly increasing confirmed_at values. The validator consumes that mapping and its stable-trailing-recheck regression explicitly accepts repeated unchanged base values.
